title: AceRooms
description: Add pvp rooms to your server
body:
# ⚔️ AceRooms

Take your server's PvP to the next level with AceRooms! This plugin allows server administrators to create dynamic, automated PvP arenas and rooms. Perfect for Practice, KitPvP, Factions, or Custom Minigames servers.

---

## ✨ Features

* **👥 Dynamic Player Capacity:** Set the exact maximum number of players allowed inside a room. The second the capacity is reached, the room locks down instantly.
* **🧱 Automated Glass Barriers:** Customize the color of the glass blocks that physically open and close the entrance to the room.
* **🔄 Reopening System:** Set a precise countdown timer before a closed room reopens. The countdown will only trigger once the player count drops below a specific threshold.
* **🧪 Integrated Potion Effects:** Automatically apply tailored status effects (like Strength, Speed, or Resistance) to any player who steps inside the room.
* **🛠️ Toggleable Build Permissions:** Decide whether players are allowed to build or break blocks within each specific room.
